summary.text: Jeremy Riddle is the Republican candidate for the Arkansas House of Representatives, District 42, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary and previously held a seat on the Greenbrier School District board.

paragraphs.text: Jeremy Riddle assumed office in 2019 as a member of the Greenbrier School District board, Zone 5, according to Ballotpedia.
In the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for District 42, he defeated Scout Stubbs, 67.7 percent to 32.3 percent.
No incumbent is running in the District 42 race.
